title: Ship the runner references in the ticfac skill and install it in the orchestrator image
description:
Since ticks v0.32.0 the ticks skill the image installs has no agent-runner/herdr-runner references, and ticfac's copies live in internal/runconfig of ticfac's own repo, which an orchestrator container working another repository cannot read. The entrypoint's fallback prompts (reboot/default/herdr guidance) now name that contract but nothing in the container carries it. Put the references under skills/ticfac/references (embedded via go:embed all:skills) and install the ticfac skill in image/Dockerfile beside the ticks one, then point the prompts at the installed path.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding 29b5ab5aeed121a01f39c1651288922cb334c85beeb8dad1940ca47028181142 (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-dz1/attempt-6): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/29b5ab5aeed121a01f39c1651288922cb334c85beeb8dad1940ca47028181142.json on the run branch.
